invitations_pending_email.name: invitations_pending_email
invitations_pending_email.where: "invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "invitations"."email" is not null

share_members_direct.name: share_members_direct
share_members_direct.value:
("share_members"."direct_role" is null) = ("share_members"."direct_can_publish" is null)
        and ("share_members"."direct_role" is null or "share_members"."direct_role" in ('reader', 'editor'))
        and ("share_members"."direct_role" is distinct from 'reader' or not "share_members"."direct_can_publish")

revisions_unnamed_copy_idx.name: revisions_unnamed_copy_idx
revisions_unnamed_copy_idx.where: "revisions"."audience" = 'published' and "revisions"."based_on" is null and "revisions"."source_revision_id" is null

revisions_one_sequence.name: revisions_one_sequence
revisions_one_sequence.value:
("revisions"."audience" = 'draft' and "revisions"."draft_seq" is not null and "revisions"."published_seq" is null)
       or ("revisions"."audience" = 'published' and "revisions"."published_seq" is not null and "revisions"."draft_seq" is null)

comments_thread_state.name: comments_thread_state
comments_thread_state.value: "comments"."thread_id" is null or ("comments"."resolved_at" is null and "comments"."deleted_at" is null)
